rationale: The Latin anchors *bulga* (leather bag/wallet), *follis* (money bag), *siliqua* (a small coin/purse), and *uter* (leather bag) all point to a small physical container for carrying money, which aligns directly with purse.n.03 ("a small bag for carrying money"). This is the literal, concrete sense, preferred over the metonymic senses (purse.n.02 = sum of money, purse.n.04 = prize money) and over the more general bag.n.04.
